Name: Cindersap Forest Cleanup (things Trash Bear forgot)
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]What does it do: (see pictures)

- Cleans up the trash in western cindersap forest.
- Cleans up the trash during the flower dance event.



INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. download the  Cindersap_Cleanup.rar
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the "[CP] Boogie Clean Cindersap Woods" folder into your Mods folder.
5. feedback is welcome, enjoy :)!

DEINSTALLATION:
1. delete the "[CP] Boogie Clean Cindersap Woods" folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Works with everything that does not edit/replace the lower western part of Forest.tbin or Forest-FlowerFestival.tbin Map.
